widgets_values:
# Using LoRAs
**Ctrl + B to enable**

For the camera LoRA we recommend setting strength = 1

You can use LTX [Ready to use camera LoRAs](https://huggingface.co/collections/Lightricks/ltx-2)




Use a second LoRa only when the details are important in the LoRa. 

## Training
We have made available a full trainer to help you to train your own LoRA. You can [find it here](https://github.com/Lightricks/LTX-2).

nodes.title: Prompting LTX-2
widgets_values:
## LTX-2 Prompting Tips
1. **Core Actions**: Describe events and actions as they occur over time  
2. **Audio**: Describe sounds and dialogue needed for the scene  
3. **Reference Image**: Do not repeat details already present  
4. **Consistency**: Avoid instructions that do not match the reference image, as this will degrade results

nodes.title: LLM Prompt https://ltx.io/model/model-blog/prompting-guide-for-ltx-2
widgets_values:
# LTX-2 Prompt Writing Guide

## Prompt Structure

Write your prompt as a **single flowing paragraph** of 4-8 descriptive sentences covering these elements:

1. **Establish the shot** — Use cinematography terms (wide, medium, close-up), specify scale and style
2. **Set the scene** — Describe lighting, color palette, textures, atmosphere
3. **Describe the action** — Write the core action as a natural sequence, beginning to end, using present tense verbs
4. **Define characters** — Include age, hairstyle, clothing, distinguishing details; express emotions through physical cues
5. **Identify camera movement** — Specify when and how the view shifts (e.g., "slow dolly in," "handheld tracking," "over-the-shoulder")
6. **Describe audio** — Ambient sounds, music, speech. Place dialogue in quotation marks; specify language/accent if needed

## What Works Well

- Cinematic compositions with thoughtful lighting and shallow depth of field
- Single-subject emotional expressions, subtle gestures, facial nuance
- Atmosphere: fog, mist, golden hour, soft shadows, rain, reflections
- Clear camera language: "slow dolly in," "handheld tracking," "over-the-shoulder"
- Stylized aesthetics named early: painterly, noir, analog film, fashion editorial, pixelated animation, surreal
- Specific lighting: backlighting, color palettes, rim light, flickering lamps
- Characters speaking or singing in various languages

## What to Avoid

- **Text and logos** — Model cannot generate readable text
- **Complex physics** — Jumping, juggling, fast-twisting motion causes artifacts (dancing works)
- **Scene overload** — Too many characters, layered actions, or excessive objects
- **Conflicting lighting** — Don't mix incompatible light sources unless clearly motivated
- **Overcomplicated prompts** — More elements = higher chance some won't appear; start simple, iterate

## Tips

- Match detail level to shot scale (close-ups need more precision than wide shots)
- Focus camera movement descriptions on the camera's relationship to the subject
- Iterate freely — fast experimentation is part of the workflow

nodes.title: Video Size
widgets_values:
Width & height settings must be divisible by 32 + 1. 
Frame count must be divisible by 8 + 1. 


Running with invalid parameters **will not cause errors**. Instead, the flow will silently choose the closest valid parameters.
blurry, low quality, still frame, frames, watermark, overlay, titles, has blurbox, has subtitles

nodes.title: Enhanced Prompt (Positive)
widgets_values: A cinematic portrait of a young woman with long straight brown hair and brown eyes wearing a white t-shirt against a light background. She is currently looking over her shoulder at the camera. She slowly turns her body to face forward, her hair sweeping naturally with the movement. As she completes the turn she tilts her head slightly, a warm smile gradually spreading across her face. She tucks a strand of hair behind her ear with one hand, then settles into a relaxed confident pose facing the camera directly with a natural genuine smile. Soft even studio lighting throughout, smooth fluid motion, intimate portrait atmosphere.
